# IR-EMPOWER 2024

**Workshop on Infrared Emissivity Measurements — first edition**

| | |
|---|---|
| **Dates** | 5–6 September 2024 |
| **Venue** | Bizkaia Aretoa, Bilbao, Spain |
| **Organized by** | Thermophysical Properties of Materials Research Group (Thermomat / HAIRL), UPV/EHU |
| **Participating institutions** | PTB · CAE · CEMHTI-CNRS · PROMES-CNRS · LTeN-CNRS · IMT Mines Albi · JRC Karlsruhe · INO-CNR · Vinča Institute · Czech Academy of Sciences (ISI Brno) · University of West Bohemia · Ruhr University Bochum · University of Wisconsin–Madison · University of Virginia · LASP Boulder · UPV/EHU |
| **Original website** | [dulcet-sundae-44ceba.netlify.app](https://dulcet-sundae-44ceba.netlify.app/) (frozen legacy copy) |

The first IR-EMPOWER brought together, over two days in Bilbao, the European
and American laboratories working on infrared emissivity measurement —
metrology institutes, high-temperature facilities, and university groups —
for twenty-one talks spanning techniques below and above 1000 K, cryogenic
and ultra-high-temperature measurement, instruments, and open data. The talk
*"Towards an Open Community of Radiative Properties"* (J. Gabirondo-López)
outlined what would become [EKHI](/data/ekhi.html) and this site.
